name: theme-extension-development
description: Frontend asset build of the TYPO3 extension theme_extension_development.

scripts.build:icons: npm run build:icons:solid && npm run build:icons:brands && npm run build:icons:meta
scripts.build:icons:solid: rm -rf Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome/Solid && mkdir -p Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome/Solid && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/svgs/solid/*.svg Resources/Public/Icons/FontAwesome/Solid/
scripts.build:icons:brands:copy: node -e "const f=require('node:fs'),d=process.env.THEME_BRANDS_DIR,n=require('./package.json').fontAwesomeBrands;if(!Array.isArray(n)||n.length===0){throw new Error('package.json has no \"fontAwesomeBrands\" allowlist.')}f.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});f.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const b of n){f.copyFileSync('node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/svgs/brands/'+b+'.svg',d+'/'+b+'.svg')}"
scripts.build:icons:verify: npm run build:icons:solid:verify && npm run build:icons:brands:verify && npm run build:icons:meta:verify
